_doc: PORTAL-RULE-1110 WP1: reviewed POLICY file read only by vera/host_role.py. One role per host: ORIGINAL | REPOSITORY_OF_RECORD | PORTAL | RESOLVER | EXCLUDED. Precedence: specificity (host+path > host > suffix; more labels first), then priority, then EXCLUDED > PORTAL > RESOLVER > REPOSITORY_OF_RECORD > ORIGINAL. A PORTAL verdict is never reopened by any other config flag; only a reviewed edit of this file changes a role. Unknown host: deny for store, allow for answer (deny-list design, plan 2.1). Not wired into any lane yet (WP3-WP7).
